text:
maya: Quick q—can we add an "override" button in Console to force a flag on for a customer for debugging? thinking: temporary, audited, and gated.
jamal: +1 for audit trail. we should also throttle it. ops folks used to flip things too often during incidents :sweat_smile:
sophia: We already have runtime flags API but no concept of 'ephemeral override'. Implementing in UI will need backend support: expiration, actor, reason, and revoke.
ryan: Convinced we need optimistic concurrency. prefer using `If-Match: "v12"` style header on PATCH to avoid races. Also need to emit a telemetry event for every override.
leah: What about permissions? only allowlist certain roles. and limit to X overrides per 24h per org. maybe 3.
maya: Agreement on perms + quota. Also need a visible label in UI that app shows when override is active so customers don't get surprised.
jamal: For telemetry schema propose: `flag.override` with fields: actor, target_org, flag_key, from, to, duration_seconds, change_id. make change_id UUID.
ops-bot: Deploy reminder: next runtime patch window is 2026-05-18 02:00 UTC, if we want quick trial push now we can do a canary to staging.
sophia: API debate: add new endpoint POST /runtime/flags/overrides or extend PATCH /runtime/flags? prefer dedicated endpoint to keep semantics clear.
ryan: Dedicated endpoint is cleaner but we must reuse existing validation and quota checks. Also, add `dry_run=true` param so we can test without toggling.
leah: UX: in Console the button should open a small modal: select duration (15m/1h/24h), add reason (mandatory), checkbox for 'visible to customer' toggle. require 2FA for >24h overrides :lock:
maya: Rollout plan: feature flag for Console toggle, backend behind `feature_override_v1`, canary to 5% of orgs, then 25%, then GA. block GA until audit log search is hooked up.
jamal: One safety: auto-expire overrides at min(duration, 24h) to avoid permanent changes from human error. plus alert if overrides active for >2h during peak.
sophia: Example event payload:
```
{
  "event":"flag.override",
  "actor":"maya",
  "flag":"route-by-cost",
  "from":0,
  "to":100,
  "duration":3600,
  "change_id":"b1f3a7d6-..."
}
```
ryan: Action items: (1) sophia add API spec PR (2) jamal add telemetry schema + event pipeline ticket (3) leah mockups for modal + perms (4) maya draft rollout playbook. I'll wire up optimistic concurrency in runtime client.
maya: thanks all — I'll slot PRs and link here. please include any security concerns. :thumbsup:
